about: The four weapons' shots, each flying along x about the middle it hits with, in field units, y down. body and core are polygons: the body takes the palette's accent and the core the field's text. tail is how far back its tail reaches from its middle, and its half width where it starts; halo is its halo's radius along it and across it and how far ahead of its middle that sits, and glow its strength; barbs are lines swept back from its head, left out under 10 pixels a unit. count is the shots a pull fires and fan the degrees between two of them. sparks are the three sizes of the spark a broken rock sheds, by how far each reaches. halo is how every soft halo fades from its middle, in a thing's own color under plain alpha: each stop is how far out it is, 0 to 1, and how much of the color shows there, and strength is what a palette of each mode multiplies that by.
